Default Wheat, Calendar (Valenzano, 23Nov07) Calibrated
7.00           : AquaCrop Version (June 2021)
0              : File protected
2              : fruit/grain producing crop
1              : Crop is sown
1              : Determination of crop cycle : by calendar days
1              : Soil water depletion factors (p) are adjusted by ETo
0.00           : Base temperature (В°C) below which crop development does not progress
26.00          : Upper temperature (В°C) above which crop development no longer increases with an increase in temperature
-9             : Total length of crop cycle in growing degree-days
0.12           : Soil water depletion factor for canopy expansion (p-exp) - Upper threshold
0.52           : Soil water depletion factor for canopy expansion (p-exp) - Lower threshold
5.8            : Shape factor for water stress coefficient for canopy expansion (0.0 = straight line)
0.75           : Soil water depletion fraction for stomatal control (p - sto) - Upper threshold
3.5            : Shape factor for water stress coefficient for stomatal control (0.0 = straight line)
0.38           : Soil water depletion factor for canopy senescence (p - sen) - Upper threshold
1.8            : Shape factor for water stress coefficient for canopy senescence (0.0 = straight line)
50             : Sum(ETo) during dormant period to be exceeded before crop is permanently wilted
1.23           : Soil water depletion factor for pollination (p - pol) - Upper threshold
6              : Vol% for Anaerobiotic point (* (SAT - [vol%]) at which deficient aeration occurs *)
50             : Considered soil fertility stress for calibration of stress response (%)
2.15           : Response of canopy expansion is not considered
0.79           : Response of maximum canopy cover is not considered
-0.21          : Response of crop Water Productivity is not considered
3.52           : Response of decline of canopy cover is not considered
-9             : dummy - Parameter no Longer required
5              : Minimum air temperature below which pollination starts to fail (cold stress) (В°C)
35             : Maximum air temperature above which pollination starts to fail (heat stress) (В°C)
14.00          : Minimum growing degrees required for full crop transpiration (В°C - day)
6              : Electrical Conductivity of soil saturation extract at which crop starts to be affected by soil salinity (dS/m)
20             : Electrical Conductivity of soil saturation extract at which crop can no longer grow (dS/m)
-9             : Dummy - no longer applicable
25             : Calibrated distortion (%) of CC due to salinity stress (Range: 0 (none) to +100 (very strong))
100            : Calibrated response (%) of stomata stress to ECsw (Range: 0 (none) to +200 (extreme))
1.10           : Crop coefficient when canopy is complete but prior to senescence (KcTr,x)
0.15           : Decline of crop coefficient (%/day) as a result of ageing, nitrogen deficiency, etc.
0.30           : Minimum effective rooting depth (m)
1.50           : Maximum effective rooting depth (m)
15             : Shape factor describing root zone expansion
0.05           : Maximum root water extraction (m3water/m3soil.day) in top quarter of root zone
0.01           : Maximum root water extraction (m3water/m3soil.day) in bottom quarter of root zone
50             : Effect of canopy cover in reducing soil evaporation in late season stage
1.50           : Soil surface covered by an individual seedling at 90 % emergence (cm2)
1.50           : Canopy size of individual plant (re-growth) at 1st day (cm2)
4500000        : Number of plants per hectare
0.04770        : Canopy growth coefficient (CGC): Increase in canopy cover (fraction soil cover per day)
-9             : Maximum decrease of Canopy Growth Coefficient in and between seasons - Not Applicable
-9             : Number of seasons at which maximum decrease of Canopy Growth Coefficient is reached - Not Applicable
-9.00          : Shape factor for decrease Canopy Growth Coefficient - Not Applicable
0.96           : Maximum canopy cover (CCx) in fraction soil cover
0.03762        : Canopy decline coefficient (CDC): Decrease in canopy cover (in fraction per day)
12             : Calendar Days: from sowing to emergence
80             : Calendar Days: from sowing to maximum rooting depth
100            : Calendar Days: from sowing to start senescence
112            : Calendar Days: from sowing to maturity (length of crop cycle)
80             : Calendar Days: from sowing to flowering
13             : Length of the flowering stage (days)
1              : Crop determinancy linked with flowering
100            : Excess of potential fruits (%)
30             : Building up of Harvest Index starting at flowering (days)

100            : Water Productivity normalized for ETo and CO2 during yield formation (as % WP*)
50             : Crop performance under elevated atmospheric CO2 concentration (%)
64             : Reference Harvest Index (HIo) (%)
5              : Possible increase (%) of HI due to water stress before flowering

7.00           : Coefficient describing negative impact on HI of stomatal closure during yield formation

-9             : GDDays: from sowing to start senescence

-9             : GDDays: from sowing to flowering
-9             : Length of the flowering stage (growing degree days)
-9.00          : CGC for GGDays: Increase in canopy cover (in fraction soil cover per growing-degree day)
-9.00          : CDC for GGDays: Decrease in canopy cover (in fraction per growing-degree day)
-9             : GDDays: building-up of Harvest Index during yield formation
90             : dry matter content (%) of fresh yield
0.00           : Minimum effective rooting depth (m) in first year - required only in case of regrowth

0              : Transfer of assimilates from above ground parts to root system is NOT considered
